cases.question: How do sliding-mode controllers reduce chattering in motor drives?

expected_refs.snippet: Sliding-Mode Control Strategies for PMSM speed control
Disturbance Observer-Based Chattering-Attenuated Terminal Sliding Mode Control

cases.fixture_answer: Chattering reduction should be explained as a design tradeoff, with PMSM SMC taxonomy context [1] and disturbance-observer terminal SMC evidence [2].
cases.recorded_answer: Sliding-mode controllers reduce chattering by treating switching gain, boundary layers, and disturbance-observer compensation as design tradeoffs. For PMSM control, the review frames chattering reduction as a core SMC research concern [1]. Chattering-attenuated terminal SMC then combines disturbance observation with terminal sliding surfaces to reduce switching ripple while preserving robustness [2].

cases.question: Compare regression and SOGIFO-X flux observers for PMSM sensorless control.

expected_refs.snippet: Regression Model-Based Flux Observer for IPMSM Sensorless Control

cases.fixture_answer: A literature-review answer should compare the regression observer's wide-speed motivation [1] with SOGIFO-X filtering and observer design claims [2].
cases.recorded_answer: A regression flux observer emphasizes model-based IPMSM sensorless operation across a wide speed range [1]. SOGIFO-X focuses on optimized filtering and observer structure for sensorless PMSM control [2]. A useful comparison should separate the regression model's speed-range motivation from the SOGIFO-X algorithm's filtering and observer-design emphasis.

cases.question: Derive the role of a reaching law when sliding-mode control must satisfy state and input constraints.

cases.fixture_answer: A derivation should start from the constrained reaching-law objective and cite the state and control-signal constraint context [1].
cases.recorded_answer: For a constrained SMC derivation, define the sliding hyperplane, then choose a reaching law that drives the representative point toward that hyperplane while respecting state constraints and control signal limitation [1]. The cited work frames this as finite-time convergence under perturbations, so the derivation should keep disturbance robustness and constraint satisfaction explicit.

cases.question: Give an implementation checklist for validating a PMSM sliding-mode controller before deployment.

expected_refs.snippet: Persistent research gaps are identified in hardware validation

cases.fixture_answer: An implementation answer should turn the PMSM SMC review's hardware-validation and real-time tuning gaps into a deployment checklist [1].
cases.recorded_answer: A PMSM SMC implementation checklist should verify sensor and sampling assumptions, switching or higher-order SMC behavior, disturbance robustness, hardware validation, energy-efficiency measurement, and real-time tuning before deployment [1]. It should also record operating envelopes and failure cases so controller claims are not limited to simulation.

cases.fixture_answer: The MATLAB-style observer skeleton should identify measured currents, voltage inputs, and switching gains, while citing the PMSM SMO context [1].
